_provenance: Arrangement GROWN by Cellular Potts annealing instead of computed from a parametric formula. Same four measured bands from truck.splat, same measure keys, so a grown form and an emitted one are scored on identical ground.
_why_this_domain_exists: A parametric emitter is computationally REDUCIBLE, so its output is never richer than the objective that asked for it -- proven by training the parametric domain against an unrelated objective and getting a completely different form (genome distance 1.372). Wolfram's minimal model gets its richness from an IRREDUCIBLE development. This domain's genome is the local adhesion rule; the shape has to be grown to be known.
_the_result_that_justified_it: UNTRAINED random rule-genomes land inside reality's clustering band 39 times out of 40 (median 6.905, band 4.679..8.172). The parametric domain manages 1 in 120 (median 1.580). Real matter is grown, so a growth process inherits the statistics of growth for free.

constraints.why: every restart must actually produce matter. A genome whose blob dissolves or never forms is not a slow answer, it is no answer -- and averaging over the runs that happened to survive would silently score it as if it had.

the coin-toss gate, and it can be set far higher here than in the parametric domain (0.35) because growth REPEATS: untrained genomes already measure 0.95-0.98. A self-sorting process converges on its own attractor from different scrambles, which is exactly what a limit cycle was for the walker.
a lattice that is 1% full has no interior, so its layering is unmeasurable and every fact read off it is noise dressed as a number.
past this the blob fills its own box and aspect stops describing the matter, only the lattice.
the target: inside reality's measured envelope on all four facts, each normalised by its own band width.

THE FOURTH SPEC AUDIT, REPAIRED. The previous winner came out 3,143 bone / 14 muscle / 543 skin -- the volume constraint is soft (lam=0.9) so muscle drained below its own genome floor to 0.4%. Differential adhesion with one dominant tissue is not differential adhesion, and nothing had required three tissues to SURVIVE, so it got one. HARD, because partial failure here is invisible in every other number: a single-tissue blob still has an aspect, a clustering and a robustness.

walls.robustness: The one maximize. Clustering is a BAND and maximizing it would drive the winner to reality's extreme rather than its typical; robustness never saturates and asks the only question that separates a rule from an accident -- does the same rule sort the same way from a different scramble?
walls.alignment_off: CLOSED BY THE NEGATIVE SPACE (2026-07-23). Grown matter measured 0.26-0.37 against a band of 0.516..0.576 because a self-sorting blob is ISOTROPIC -- nothing inside it prefers a direction. Real material's grain never comes from inside either; it comes from the environment it formed in. The genome now describes the negative space the matter must grow AROUND, and alignment EMERGES: neg_order 0.00/0.25/0.50/0.75/1.00 -> alignment 0.355/0.390/0.439/0.568/0.645, crossing reality's band at about 0.75. First attempt used parallel LAMELLAE and produced no trend at all, because a plane has no unique long axis -- alignment needs 1D confinement (channels), which is also why fibre grain comes from extrusion and not from bedding.
walls.grew: A HARD gate rather than a soft penalty on purpose. Partial failure here is invisible in an average: measure() would quietly report the mean of whichever restarts survived.

_honest_limit: 40^3 lattice, 26 sweeps, 3 restarts. Bigger blobs need proportionally more sweeps to anneal, so a form that looks settled here may not be settled at scale. The GPU makes that affordable to check and it has not been checked.
_round_2: Negative space added. Alignment is no longer trained toward -- it is a consequence of the environment's coherence, which is the only place real grain comes from.
